_quarto:
  tests:

      noErrors: true

      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ["NESTED-DIV-MARKER-XYZ", "NESTED-DIV-SECOND-XYZ", "NESTED-LIST-MARKER-XYZ"]
        - ["Q-17-4", "not expanded"]
